entries.b04ed4d0b7f7ef74: The core business designs, manufactures and sells large photomasks, which are the master plates required for manufacturing liquid crystal panels and organic EL panels. Photomasks are master plates used to transfer the patterns of control circuits and color filters for liquid crystals and organic EL onto substrates. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥28,776 million. Production is handled by the Kyoto Plant, the Shiga Plant and Taiwan's Dingzheng Technology Co., Ltd., and sales are handled by subsidiaries in China and Korea.
